messages:
Iris Tan: Heads-up: competitor "FeatherVectors" launched a low-cost vector tier today. Sales pinged me asking if we plan to match.
Marco Silva: skimmed their doc. It's basically dim-reduction + int8 packaging for hosted only. Price undercuts ours by ~35%.
Evan Park: engineering note: implementing an int8 serving path and separate packaging is doable but touches our scoring pipeline and cache formats. Risk: similarity index compatibility.
Lena Brooks: My instinct is avoid full parity. Recommend a scoped "Vectors Lite" alpha: hosted-only, limited guarantees, clear pod labels—let us measure signal before expanding.
Iris Tan: Proposed alpha acceptance: 1) >=30% cost reduction; 2) <=6% drop on our eval recall; 3) auto-fallback routing + kill-switch; 4) GTM FAQ set.
Marco Silva: Add metric hooks: per-customer recall delta and billable event correlation. Also A/B experimentation support.
Evan Park: timeline: ~4-5 weeks for hosted-only alpha if we reuse index format; +3 weeks if we change index layout. Need decision on index reuse.
Lena Brooks: Sales asks for ETA within 10 days. Can Product commit to alpha target of 5 weeks to calm inbound pressure?
Iris Tan: Decision: proceed with hosted-only Vectors Lite alpha, reuse index format for alpha to hit 5-week target. Owners: Iris (product), Evan (eng), Marco (metrics), Lena (GTM).
ci-bot: Pipeline check: creating ticket VECT-LITE-001 and assigning to Evan Park.
